title: 12″ Gear Premium Cassidy Canteen Base Bong
description:
The Gear Premium 12″ Cassidy Canteen Base Bong Limited Edition is constructed of 100% borosilicate glass for durability. The bong features a built-in ice catcher as well as a large canteen chamber that offers stability with bigger clouds.
Top it all off with a 24K gold decal for a clean, high-end look, the 12″ Cassidy Canteen Base Bong will be a perfect staple in any luxurious glass collection.
